phases.expected_text: A silver compass marks the beginning of this deliberate native shutdown check. The local speech server is preparing a complete spoken passage while the application waits for its response. The observer must find the actual synthesis and graph computation on a sampled stack before sending the shutdown signal. Owned request threads must finish before their model resources are released. A fresh server will then speak a separate short reply, and the output device must consume that whole reply. This pending request ends with emerald forest.
